note: Rankings reflect the 3.7 meta; editorial opinion based on community tier lists.

members.name: Hsin
members.note: The new premier Electro DPS; defines 3.7's Unison and Electro Flare meta.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Top-tier Heavy Attack buffer and healer; core of the best Fusion and Aero teams.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: Premier Spectro sub-DPS; a universal Liberation amplifier for burst teams.

members.name: Lucilla
members.note: Best-in-slot Glacio Chafe support; niche, but unmatched inside her teams.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Still the game's best sustain; Crit buffs that fit literally every team.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Top Fusion support; heals, buffs, and accelerates Off-Tune teams.

members.name: Aemeath
members.note: Premier Fusion carry with one of the highest damage ceilings in 3.7.

members.name: Hiyuki
members.note: Elite Glacio hypercarry; the Chafe mechanic's best payoff.

members.name: Sigrika
members.note: Top Aero DPS and Echo Skill scaler; a single-target monster.

members.name: Suisui
members.note: The Negative Status support; raises stack caps for every status team.

members.name: Jingran
members.note: Premier Fusion Heavy Attack hypercarry; anchors a top meta team.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: Best Havoc Bane support for status teams, but needs the right team around her.

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Devastating Electro DPS; slightly edged out by newer carries.

members.name: Cartethyia
members.note: Still an elite Aero Erosion DPS; power-crept but far from dead.

members.name: Ciaccona
members.note: Essential Aero Erosion enabler; her support value keeps her high.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Free, universal healer and buffer; every account's safety net.

members.name: Electro Rover
members.note: Shot up the ranks in 3.7 as Hsin's best Electro Flare battery.

members.name: Carlotta
members.note: Solid Glacio DPS, but Hiyuki has taken her crown.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Best free 4-star sub-DPS; a great buffer, outscaled by limited 5-stars.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Budget Heavy Attack buffer; does the job for free.

members.name: Buling
members.note: Handy Electro Flare support for Hsin teams on a budget.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: Free and flexible; replaced once limited options arrive.

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: Former queen of the meta; now needs heavy investment to keep up.
